title: Maritime quarantine
question: How did ships, ports, and quarantine institutions shape exposure and public-health responses?
scope: Mediterranean and Atlantic quarantine histories, with Grosse Île as a documented institutional case. This is a selective reading collection, not a systematic review.
strategies: site.cdc.gov Tognotti lessons history quarantine plague influenza 2013 19 2 254
Source chaining from the existing Maritime Disease Atlas bibliography: Lind and Booker.
editorial_note: Read the institutional history alongside the disease mechanism. A quarantine rule, a delay at anchor, and a death count describe different parts of the process. The Lind and Booker entries are metadata leads; they are not labeled as completed full-text reviews.
